settings.about:
24 Heelz NG is a Nigerian online store for ladies' heels. Our promise is simple: quality for less.
We confirm every order personally on WhatsApp, so you know your size, price and delivery details before you pay.
settings.delivery: We deliver across Nigeria. The delivery fee and time depend on your city, and we confirm both with you on WhatsApp before you pay.
settings.returns: If your pair arrives damaged or in the wrong size, message us on WhatsApp as soon as you receive it, with a photo, and we will arrange an exchange where possible.
settings.payment: Payment details are shared with you on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.
